worldcombat.skill.perishsong.summary: Sings a three-beat song: every living thing that hears it within the radius, the singer included, goes down when the count runs out. Disengaging or being cured shakes it off. It is a mutual-destruction song, worth it only when you can outlast the foe or already intend to trade lives.
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.use.0: Level the fight when you are losing and force a rush or a retreat
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.use.1: Name a whole crowd at once
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.use.2: Take the enemy's main threat with you in a lost exchange
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.description: At the moment the song starts, every living thing within %1$s blocks - friend or foe, the singer included - is written onto the list; each beat lasts %2$s, and when three beats are done they all go down together.
Starting the song takes %1$s, with a %2$s cooldown. Falling out of combat for a while or being cured with milk shakes the song off without settling.
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.dirge.0: Dirge: the song carries farther and each beat is longer, but the cooldown is longer.
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.dirge.1: Lullaby: the song is closer and each beat is shorter with a shorter cooldown - a smaller list, settled faster.
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.timing: Cast around yourself: after %1$s of preparation it spends %3$s PP; the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %4$s from commit.
On: song radius x1.3, beat x1.35, cooldown x1.15. Off (Lullaby): radius x0.85, beat x0.75, cooldown x0.85. Trade the size of the list for how fast it settles.
The partner starts the song only below this health ratio; larger levels the fight sooner, smaller keeps it for when it truly cannot hold.
The partner considers the song only while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger will sing at a farther foe.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to start the song.
world_combat.move.perishsong.text.song: Perish Song: down in %1$s beats (%2$s heard)
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.description: The list is fixed the moment the song starts, so stepping back out of the radius no longer frees anyone; when the three beats end it takes each listed creature's entire current health at once.
